name: Methodist Girls' School
summary: Established girls’ school with strong academics and co-curricular reputation.
body: MGS is a well-known local girls’ school frequently referenced in secondary-school conversations among PR/citizen families. Included for landscape completeness — admissions follow MOE frameworks rather than international open enrolment. Confirm admin-portal alert settings for forms and lost-property notices; dual-career parents need one named notification owner, not mutual mute.
